# Veri(dis)similitude (Salvo MA) — Analysis Overview & Index

**What this folder is:** a complete repurposing analysis of Dalton Salvo's MA thesis *Veri(dis)similitude: The Rhetorical Force Generated by VR Technology* (67 pp.), decomposing all of its conceptual moves, theoretical claims, and its *Gnomes & Goblins* artifact analysis, and **re-grounding** them onto the **RODA** game-behavior method (v9) for **Part II** of the dissertation. Output lives in **two homes**: this structured folder, and the Part-II working dossier at `tmp/Dissertation/Part_II/Part-II-GG-Repurpose/`.

**Why it's not a standard corpus index:** the other `corpus/index/` folders index *external* sources to be cited across the dissertation. This thesis is the author's *own* prior work being *rewritten into* Part II — so the analysis is pointed at **migration** (keep / re-ground / enrich / supersede), not citation-mining.

**Headline finding:** the thesis is a **near-complete proto-RODA analysis**. It already anticipates four of RODA's five pillars (recalcitrance ≈ the unserviceable rock; incorporation ≈ "true presence/dwelling"; rupture ≈ anxiety/miniaturization; the chain-loop ≈ Uexküll's functional circle). Only the **Aristotelian A0→A4 spine** is wholly absent — and Part I supplies it. RODA v9 even **already absorbed** the thesis's own concepts (*veri(dis)similitude*, A0 supplanting, room-scale kinesthesis, miniaturization-as-rupture), so the re-grounding is largely a homecoming.

## How to use this folder (reading order for writing Part II)
1. **`../../tmp/Dissertation/Part_II/Part-II-GG-Repurpose/repurpose-crosswalk.md`** — the section-by-section migration map + proposed Part-II chapter spine. **Start here.**
2. **`gg-RODA-matrix.md`** — the filled analysis kernel: the **miniaturization** (full Steps 0–7, ontological-change) + the **candle opener** (discrete pass). This is the analytical core of the chapter.
3. **`../../tmp/.../vr-vs-screen-differential.md`** — the promoted general-VR-theory module (the VR↔screen backbone).
4. **`../../tmp/.../gaps-to-add.md`** — the net-new apparatus (your contribution), with slots + effort ordering.
5. **`../../tmp/.../concept-reconciliation.md`** — vocabulary fixes (esp. the **"compulsion" rename**).
6. **`gg-element-matrix.md`** — every G&G element × RODA, for the artifact-analysis sections.
7. Reference: **`vds-claims-moves.md`** (157 claims/moves), **`vds-terminology.md`** (29 terms), **`vds-interlocutor-loci.md`** (21 sources), **`gg-frame-trace.md`** (verified footage).
